newsitem.title: USA: Kroger Co to make two-for-one stock split.
newsitem.headline: Kroger Co to make two-for-one stock split.

text.p: Kroger Co said Thursday it was going to make a two-for-one stock split of its common stock, effective April 4.
The company said the board of directors was confident in the long-term performance and strength of Kroger.

"The Company's increased sales, cash flow and earnings in each of the past four years, the reduction of long-term debt and our investment in new stores and technology have all been factors in the steady increase in Kroger's stock price," it said.
A company spokesman said its total circulation was about 132 million in diluted shares against 129.2 million a year ago. The figures are before the split.
On Thursday, Kroger's stock closed at 53-1/2 on the New York Stock Exchange, against 53-7/8 the previous day.
In January, Kroger reported an operating share profit of $0.95 for the fourth quarter against $0.84 a year ago.
